page.overview:
Who is Taiyi Zhenren?

Sun Wukong went up to the Wondrous Cliff Palace to fetch Taiyi Zhenren due his escaped Nine-Headed Lion menacing the Jade Flower Province. Taiyi Zhenren came down and immediately subjugated the Nine-Headed Lion with his presence alone.
